title: Structural Pattern Matching: Specification
summary: Specifies the syntax and semantics of the match statement and pattern syntax for structural pattern matching in Python.

title: Allow writing union types as X | Y
summary: Introduces the syntax X | Y for type annotations as an alternative to typing.Union[X, Y].

title: Parameter Specification Variables
summary: Introduces typing.ParamSpec to enable typing of callables that forward their parameters to other callables.

title: Add Optional Length-Checking To zip
summary: Adds the optional strict boolean keyword argument to the zip built-in function to verify all iterables are of equal length.

title: Precise line numbers for debugging and other tools
summary: Provides precise and reliable line numbers for Python bytecode execution to support debugging and profiling tools.

title: What's New In Python 3.10
summary: Covers major additions in Python 3.10 including structural pattern matching, parenthesized context managers, and improved error reporting.

title: Exception Groups and except*
summary: Introduces ExceptionGroup and new except* syntax to support raising and handling multiple independent exceptions simultaneously.

title: Include Fine-Grained Error Locations in Tracebacks
summary: Enhances tracebacks by displaying exact column ranges indicating the specific expression or subexpression that raised an error.

title: Self Type
summary: Introduces typing.Self to concisely annotate methods that return an instance of their own class.

title: Arbitrary Literal String Type
summary: Introduces typing.LiteralString to ensure strings accepted by security-sensitive APIs are composed exclusively from string literals.

title: tomllib: Support for Parsing TOML in the Standard Library
summary: Adds the tomllib standard library module for fast parsing of TOML documents based on tomli.

title: What's New In Python 3.11
summary: Details major additions in Python 3.11 including Faster CPython optimizations, fine-grained tracebacks, and exception groups.

title: Type Parameter Syntax
summary: Introduces clean type parameter syntax for generic classes and functions, plus the type statement for creating type aliases.

title: Syntactic formalization of f-strings
summary: Formalizes f-string grammar in the PEG parser, removing restrictions on quotes, backslashes, comments, and nesting levels.

title: A Per-Interpreter GIL
summary: Introduces per-interpreter Global Interpreter Locks, allowing isolated subinterpreters to run truly concurrently in separate OS threads.

title: Low Impact Monitoring for CPython
summary: Defines a low-impact execution event monitoring API for profilers, debuggers, and coverage measurement tools.

title: Using TypedDict for more precise **kwargs typing
summary: Allows typing **kwargs with TypedDict to specify valid keyword arguments and their corresponding value types.

title: What's New In Python 3.12
summary: Overview of Python 3.12 updates including formalized f-strings, new type parameter syntax, and per-interpreter GIL.

title: Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython
summary: Details making the Global Interpreter Lock optional in CPython to support multi-threaded parallelism without a global lock.

title: JIT Compilation
summary: Introduces an experimental copy-and-patch Just-In-Time compiler architecture to accelerate Python execution.

title: Consistent Views of Variable Names and Values
summary: Provides consistent, defined semantics for accessing local variables and frame introspection across scopes.

title: What's New In Python 3.13
summary: Describes Python 3.13 changes including an improved interactive REPL with multiline editing, experimental free-threading, and JIT compiler.
